item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 06/May/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A trough of low pressure will bring heavy showers and squally thunderstorms to southern China tomorrow and on Monday at first. Under the influence of the associated strong easterly airstream, it will be slightly cooler and the weather will become brighter gradually over the coast of Guangdong early to midweek next week. Besides, an area of low pressure will bring unsettled weather to the southern part of the South China Sea in the next couple of days.

Date/Month: 07/05 (Sunday)
Wind: South force 3, becoming north force 4.
Weather: Mainly cloudy with occasional showers. Showers will be heavier over some areas with squally thunderstorms later.
Temp range: 24 - 28 C
R.H. range: 80 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High

Date/Month: 08/05 (Monday)
Wind: North to northeast force 4 to 5, becoming east force 5 later, occasionally force 6 offshore.
Weather: Cloudy with occasional showers. Showers will be more frequent with squally thunderstorms at first. Showers will ease off gradually during the day.
Temp range: 22 - 25 C
